subject: Finbridge: urgent SLO incident & request to preserve runtime logs
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@finbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: High error rate + latency spike — need logs preserved and exec escalation

Hi Olga,

We're seeing a major spike across a subset of our requests this morning (between 08:45-09:05 PT) — error rate jumped to ~18% and p50 latency spiked from ~120ms to ~2.2s. Our payments team is blocked on reconciliation and Finance is asking for audit evidence.

Can you confirm Redwood has preserved all runtime logs and traces for our org for the time window? We need a copy of the relevant request traces, error logs, and any rate-limit/fallback events. Also need confirmation this data will be held and not purged while we investigate (our internal compliance team will request chain-of-custody).

Attaching a screenshot of the dashboard. Please escalate — this is impacting production.

Thanks,
Samira
Samira Khan
SRE Lead, Finbridge
samira@finbridge.com

Subject: Re: High error rate + latency spike — need logs preserved and exec escalation

Samira — thank you for the heads up and the dashboard screenshot. We're on it.

Action items from Redwood (initial):
- Marcus and SRE will create an immediate retention hold for all Finbridge runtime logs and traces for 2027-02-02 08:30:00 through 2027-02-02 10:00:00 PT.
- We'll collect raw request-level traces, error stacks, and router metrics; a sanitized bundle will be prepared for your team and for audit.
- Evelyn (Head of Ops) and I are standing by for executive sync if Finbridge needs escalation. Neha will coordinate customer communications and any commercial remediation.

Please confirm: do you want full raw bundles (contains headers/URLs and possible PII) or a sanitized extract (hashed IDs, removed/minimized headers)? We can produce both but full raw bundles require a signed data-access agreement and will go through our legal review.

I'll update in this thread with ETA for the log bundle.

- Olga

Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: High error rate + latency spike — need logs preserved and exec escalation

Hi all — Marcus (SRE) here; quick technical status and preservation steps.

What we see so far:
- There was a short-lived routing congestion on a subset of instances in us-west-2 that correlated with elevated tokenization backlog for long-context requests. This produced timeouts and increased CPU stall counts on the worker pool.
- Affected time window: 2027-02-02T08:42:00Z -> 2027-02-02T09:03:00Z (UTC).

Preservation steps executed (now):
1) Initiated retention hold: snapshot of request logs, router metrics, kv-cache events, and worker-level kernel traces for the affected instances.
2) Created read-only archive in a secure S3 bucket with restricted IAM (bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/finbridge/20270202/).
3) Captured a list of instance IDs, container images, and kernel versions for chain-of-custody.

Deliverables and ETA:
- Full raw bundle (tar.gz) with all logs and traces: available for internal Redwoods only by EOD 2027-02-03; production-grade export for customer review after legal signoff (estimated 48hrs after internal review).
- Sanitized bundle (hashed request IDs, removed sensitive headers) for Finbridge review: ETA 2027-02-03 15:00 PT.

Notes on PII: some request headers may contain email addresses or small PII fragments. We'll mark those fields and provide a sanitized extract by default. If Finbridge requests full raw logs for forensic purposes we will require a signed data transfer agreement and will redact only at the direction of Finbridge + Legal.

I'll attach a short inventory manifest in this thread once the archive completes.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_runtime_logs_20270202.tar.gz (will be uploaded to secure bucket)

Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: High error rate + latency spike — need logs preserved and exec escalation

Samira — quick summary and request for written confirmation to close the preservation loop from our side.

Summary:
- Redwood has initiated a retention hold for Finbridge artifacts covering 2027-02-02T08:30:00-2027-02-02T10:00:00 PT and collected raw traces, router metrics, worker kernel traces, and instance metadata.
- A sanitized bundle (hashed IDs, headers minimized) will be available to Finbridge by 2027-02-03 15:00 PT; the full raw archive is stored in a restricted S3 bucket pending a signed data-access agreement.
- Marcus will provide an inventory manifest (file list + instance IDs + checksums) for chain-of-custody; legal and security will produce a short attestation of evidence handling.

Request: please confirm via reply to this email that Finbridge requests Redwood to: 1) preserve the artifacts listed above until Finbridge confirms investigation complete or issues a written disposal request, and 2) permit Redwood Legal to share limited audit artifacts with Finbridge under NDA (we will circulate a one-page DTA). A simple reply like "Confirmed — preserve and proceed with sanitized bundle" is sufficient to trigger our next steps.

We will not release raw bundles until we have the signed DTA.

Thanks again for flagging this, and we appreciate your patience while we get you the evidence you need.

- Olga
